title: Data warehouse split: models/temporal in warehouse_sources, schedules/facade in data_warehouse
answers: Where is the Temporal data_imports code?
Which product owns schedules vs workflows for external data?
body:
- Models, Temporal workflows, CDC live in `products/warehouse_sources/backend/` (`models/external_data_source.py`, `models/external_data_schema.py`, `models/external_data_job.py`, `temporal/data_imports/`). There is NO `posthog/temporal/data_imports`.
- Schedules live in `products/data_warehouse/backend/logic/data_load/service.py` (owns Temporal schedules, not workflow bodies).
- Status enums: `warehouse_sources/backend/facade/types.py:ExternalDataSourceStatus` (Running/Paused/Error/Completed/Cancelled), `ExternalDataSchemaStatus` (Running/Paused/Failed/Completed/BillingLimitReached/BillingLimitTooLow), `ExternalDataSchemaSyncType` (full_refresh, incremental, append, webhook, cdc, xmin).
- Schema is the schedulable/pausable unit; source `status` is deprecated in favour of schema status.
- Facades: `data_warehouse/backend/facade/api.py` is a lazy PEP 562 re-export table (`_LAZY` + `__getattr__`) to avoid import cycle with warehouse_sources and keep temporalio off django.setup; `warehouse_sources/backend/facade/pipelines.py` does the same for Temporal internals (e.g. CDCExtractionInput).
- `ExternalDataSchemaQuerySet.update` is the chokepoint for bulk disables/deletes and dispatches teardown.
says: Where are external data source and schema models defined?
Which product team owns the sync schedule for external data?
How are external data imports split between warehouse products?
Where does the system define valid external data sync types?
search: Data warehouse functionality is split between two products: products/warehouse_sources/backend/ owns models (ExternalDataSource, ExternalDataSchema, ExternalDataJob in models/), Temporal workflows (temporal/data_imports/), and CDC logic; products/data_warehouse/backend/ owns schedules (data_load/service.py). There is NO posthog/temporal/data_imports directory. Status enums live in warehouse_sources/backend/facade/types.py (ExternalDataSourceStatus, ExternalDataSchemaStatus with Running/Paused/Error/Completed/Failed/BillingLimitReached states, and ExternalDataSchemaSyncType modes). Schemas are the schedulable/pausable unit; source status is deprecated. Facades in both products use lazy PEP 562 re-exports (_LAZY + __getattr__) to avoid import cycles and keep temporalio off django.setup. ExternalDataSchemaQuerySet.update is the chokepoint for bulk operations.
